sections.title: NUANCED OPINIONS AND DISCUSSION
sections.instruction: Choose the expression that best fits the speaker's attitude and the context.

sections.title: SUGGESTIONS AND ADVICE
sections.instruction: Choose the most appropriate suggestion, advice, or response.

sections.title: FORMAL REQUESTS, OFFERS, AND INVITATIONS
sections.instruction: Choose the expression that best suits the level of formality and the situation.

sections.title: APOLOGIES, THANKS, COMPLIMENTS, AND CONGRATULATIONS
sections.instruction: Choose the most natural and appropriate response in each situation.

sections.title: CLARIFICATION, PREFERENCES, AND PROBABILITY
sections.instruction: Choose the expression that best completes the exchange.

questions.prompt:
A: “The school is considering keeping the library open until 6 p.m.”
B: “____. It would give students more time to study, although the school would need to arrange adequate supervision.”
choices: On balance, I support the proposal.
I am entirely opposed to the proposal.
I have not been informed about the proposal.
I would prefer to close the library earlier.
I cannot see how the proposal relates to studying.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Qualified Agreement.

Penjelasan: Jawaban A benar menunjukkan bahwa pembicara mendukung usulan tersebut setelah mempertimbangkan kelebihan dan hal yang perlu disiapkan. Kalimat berikutnya menyebutkan manfaatnya, tetapi juga mengingatkan perlunya pengawasan.

questions.prompt:
A: “All social media content should be treated as misinformation.”
B: “____. The reliability of a post depends on its source and supporting evidence.”
choices: I couldn't agree more with that generalization.
I would be cautious about making such a sweeping claim.
That conclusion is beyond dispute.
I am delighted to hear about it.
I apologize for the misunderstanding.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Tactful Disagreement.

Penjelasan: Jawaban B benar menyatakan ketidaksetujuan dengan cara yang sopan. Pembicara menilai bahwa pernyataan tersebut terlalu umum, karena keandalan informasi bergantung pada sumber dan buktinya.

questions.prompt:
A: “Do you expect the new mentoring scheme to improve attendance?”
B: “____, but we will need to monitor the figures over the next few months.”
choices: It is guaranteed to do so.
It has already done so.
It may well do.
There is no possibility of that.
I would rather not attend.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Expressing a Tentative Opinion.

Penjelasan: Jawaban C benar menunjukkan bahwa pembicara menganggap hal itu mungkin terjadi, tetapi belum bisa dipastikan. Kalimat berikutnya menyebutkan bahwa hasilnya masih perlu dipantau.

questions.prompt:
A: “The revised timetable is more convenient, but it leaves some students with a long gap between lessons.”
B: “____. However, the change does make the afternoon schedule more manageable.”
choices: Your concern is irrelevant, and the timetable is perfect.
I completely withdraw my support for the timetable.
I am unable to understand what a timetable is.
I take your point about the long gap.
I would like to congratulate you on the timetable.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Acknowledging a Concern.

Penjelasan: Jawaban D benar menunjukkan bahwa pembicara memahami kekhawatiran lawan bicara. Setelah itu, kata “However” digunakan untuk menyampaikan sisi positif dari perubahan jadwal.

questions.prompt:
A: “I'm thinking of discussing the disagreement with the whole committee during tomorrow's meeting.”
B: “____. It may be easier to resolve the issue if you speak to the coordinator privately first.”
choices: You should make the disagreement public immediately.
If I were you, I would avoid speaking to anyone.
There is no point in trying to resolve it.
I insist that you cancel the meeting.
You might want to raise the issue with the coordinator privately first.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Giving Diplomatic Advice.

Penjelasan: Jawaban E benar memberi saran dengan sopan dan tidak memaksa. Berbicara secara pribadi dengan koordinator bisa membantu menyelesaikan masalah sebelum dibahas di depan banyak orang.

questions.prompt:
A: “Some students are unsure whether the new study schedule will work.”
B: “____ for one month before making a final decision?”
choices: Perhaps we could trial the arrangement
I would rather we ignored the feedback
It is impossible for us to consider the schedule
You should have cancelled the arrangement
I am certain that everyone has agreed
questions.explanation:
Skill: Making a Practical Suggestion.

Penjelasan: Jawaban A benar mengusulkan agar jadwal dicoba selama satu bulan. Kata “Perhaps” membuat usulan terdengar lebih halus, bukan seperti perintah.

questions.prompt:
A: “We could move the event outdoors to save on venue costs.”
B: “____. We would need a reliable alternative if the weather changes.”
choices: That is completely out of the question.
That might be workable, provided we have a backup plan.
I couldn't agree more, and no further planning is needed.
I have no idea why the event exists.
Let's cancel every part of the event.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Responding to a Suggestion with Reservation.

Penjelasan: Jawaban B benar menunjukkan bahwa usulan bisa diterima, tetapi ada syarat yang harus dipenuhi. Syaratnya adalah menyiapkan rencana cadangan jika cuaca berubah.

questions.prompt:
A: “The application form is rather complicated, and the deadline is approaching.”
B: “____ the requirements carefully before submitting anything.”
choices: You are required to ignore
I would rather you forgot
I would recommend checking
There is no reason to read
I congratulate you on submitting
questions.explanation:
Skill: Giving a Recommendation.

Penjelasan: Jawaban C benar menggunakan “I would recommend” untuk menyampaikan saran secara sopan. Memeriksa persyaratan dapat membantu menghindari kesalahan sebelum formulir dikirim.

questions.prompt:
A: “____ to have the revised draft by Thursday afternoon?”
B: “I'll do my best to send it by then.”
choices: You must send me the revised draft
I insist that you finish it
Why don't we receive
Would it be possible
I wonder whether you had sent
questions.explanation:
Skill: Making a Formal Request.

Penjelasan: Jawaban D benar adalah “Would it be possible ...?”, ungkapan yang sopan untuk meminta sesuatu. Respons lawan bicara menunjukkan bahwa ia berusaha memenuhi permintaan tersebut.

questions.prompt:
A: “You seem to have a lot of materials to carry.”
B: “____ take some of them to the staff room for you?”
A: “That's very kind of you.”
choices: Do you have to
Have you considered
Are you able to
I would rather
Would you like me to
questions.explanation:
Skill: Offering Assistance.

Penjelasan: Jawaban E benar adalah “Would you like me to ...?”, yang digunakan untuk menawarkan bantuan. Respons “That's very kind of you” menunjukkan bahwa tawaran tersebut diterima dengan baik.

questions.prompt:
A: “We would be delighted if you could attend the student research presentation next Friday.”
B: “____. Thank you for including me.”
choices: I would be delighted to attend.
I'm afraid I won't be able to attend.
I have already made other plans.
I don't think invitations are necessary.
Perhaps you should ask someone else.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Accepting a Formal Invitation.

Penjelasan: Jawaban A benar menerima undangan dengan sopan dan sesuai untuk situasi formal. Ucapan terima kasih setelahnya memperjelas bahwa pembicara bersedia hadir.

questions.prompt:
A: “Would you be available to join the committee meeting on Saturday?”
B: “____. I have already committed to a family event that day.”
choices: That sounds excellent; count me in.
Thank you, but I'm afraid I won't be able to make it.
I'd be happy to join.
I look forward to seeing everyone.
I completely agree with the proposal.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Declining an Invitation Politely.

Penjelasan: Jawaban B benar menolak undangan dengan sopan. Pembicara juga memberikan alasan, yaitu sudah memiliki acara keluarga pada hari itu.

questions.prompt:
A: “I'm sorry I overlooked the updated figures in the report. I'll correct them and send a revised copy by noon.”
B: “____. Please let me know if you need any help checking the figures.”
choices: You should never make mistakes again.
I completely disagree with your apology.
I appreciate you letting me know and taking responsibility.
Congratulations on the report.
I would rather not discuss the figures.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Responding to an Apology.

Penjelasan: Jawaban C benar menerima penjelasan dan menunjukkan penghargaan karena orang tersebut mau bertanggung jawab. Kalimat berikutnya menawarkan bantuan, bukan memperpanjang masalah.

questions.prompt:
A: “Thank you for staying late to help me prepare the presentation.”
B: “____. We were all working towards the same deadline.”
choices: You should thank me more often.
I'm sorry you had to prepare it.
I don't think the presentation matters.
It was no trouble; I'm glad I could contribute.
I would rather work alone next time.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Responding Modestly to Thanks.

Penjelasan: Jawaban D benar adalah respons yang rendah hati terhadap ucapan terima kasih. “It was no trouble” berarti bantuan tersebut tidak merepotkan.

questions.prompt:
A: “Your analysis brought a useful perspective to the discussion.”
B: “____. The team's feedback helped me refine it.”
choices: I don't believe you.
That's not your concern.
I wish you hadn't noticed.
You should do it yourself.
That's kind of you to say.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Responding to a Compliment.

Penjelasan: Jawaban E benar menerima pujian dengan sopan. Ungkapan “That's kind of you to say” menunjukkan bahwa pembicara menghargai komentar tersebut.

questions.prompt:
A: “Congratulations on having your research selected for the regional showcase!”
B: “____. I couldn't have done it without my supervisor's guidance.”
choices: Thank you; I really appreciate that.
I'm sorry I missed the event.
I don't think that's possible.
Please accept my apology.
I would rather not take part.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Responding to Congratulations.

Penjelasan: Jawaban A benar menerima ucapan selamat dengan sopan. Pembicara juga mengakui bantuan pembimbingnya dalam mencapai keberhasilan tersebut.

questions.prompt:
A: “The proposal needs to be scalable.”
B: “____? Do you mean it should also work if the number of students increases?”
A: “Exactly.”
choices: Would you mind waiting outside
Could you clarify what you mean by “scalable”
Do you agree that it is impossible
Would you rather work alone
Shall I submit it tomorrow
questions.explanation:
Skill: Asking for Clarification.

Penjelasan: Jawaban B benar meminta penjelasan lebih lanjut tentang arti “scalable”. Pertanyaan setelahnya menunjukkan bahwa pembicara ingin memastikan maksud istilah tersebut.

questions.prompt:
A: “Please send me the draft by Wednesday. The final version is due next Monday.”
B: “____, the Wednesday deadline is for the draft, not the final version?”
A: “That's correct.”
choices: I would rather not check
Could you invite the whole team
So, if I've understood correctly
I have no preference about the deadline
Would you mind cancelling the task
questions.explanation:
Skill: Checking Understanding.

Penjelasan: Jawaban C benar digunakan untuk memastikan bahwa informasi telah dipahami dengan tepat. Pembicara mengulang inti informasi tentang dua tenggat waktu untuk meminta konfirmasi.

questions.prompt:
A: “Which of the two proposals would you choose?”
B: “____ the second one, mainly because it seems more sustainable in the long term.”
choices: I have no opinion about
I insist that everyone reject
I am unable to understand
I would be inclined to choose
I congratulate you on choosing
questions.explanation:
Skill: Expressing a Considered Preference.

Penjelasan: Jawaban D benar adalah ungkapan halus untuk menyatakan pilihan. Pembicara memilih proposal kedua dan memberikan alasan yang mendukung pilihannya.

questions.prompt:
A: “Will the outdoor exhibition go ahead tomorrow?”
B: “____, although the organizers are still checking the weather forecast.”
choices: It is impossible under every circumstance
It has definitely been cancelled
I have no preference either way
I completely disagree with you
There is a good chance it will
questions.explanation:
Skill: Expressing Probability.

Penjelasan: Jawaban E benar menunjukkan bahwa acara kemungkinan besar tetap berlangsung, tetapi belum pasti. Bagian akhir kalimat menjelaskan bahwa penyelenggara masih memeriksa prakiraan cuaca.
